history.summary: EN4 lies within Enfield. Formed in 1965 from Enfield, Edmonton, and Southgate. Forty Hall, a Jacobean mansion built in 1629, and the former Royal Small Arms Factory (source of the Lee-Enfield rifle name) are notable local landmarks.
